note: Calegari argues mathematicians should meet AI progress with optimism, using OpenAI’s 6 October release as the main example. He praises some ideas in the manuscripts but criticises their writing, errors and attribution, and proposes six changes, from judging all work as if AI-assisted to reforming hiring, journals, graduate training and seminars, and taking ownership of AI results.
title: Mathematics has changed. Let’s act like it
who: Frank Calegari (University of Chicago), guest post on Terence Tao’s blog
